sentence: Chowdy the room. Save your falasha for someone who already left.

wombos.definition: A bilingual greeting that combines Italian and Texan salutations into one word. Used when addressing a mixed crowd of Italian speakers and Texans to greet everyone at once.
wombos.example: He walked into the room and said 'Chowdy!' to the whole crowd.

wombos.definition: A false, misinformed narrative delivered with full confidence — someone telling you something that is clearly incorrect and based on bad information. A brainwashed saga presented as fact.
